sonnet.problem: Card 9 already asks about verse 50, where anyone who eats the bread from heaven does not die. Card 11 asks about verse 51, where anyone who eats the living bread lives forever. These are two lines making the same point, and the answer to card 11 is nearly given by card 9's answer, so it re-asks the same fact.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
